title: Solar Front Identification: Code and Data

creators.name: Podladchikova, Olena
creators.affiliation: National Technical University of Ukraine, Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic Institute; Leibniz Institute for Astrophysics Potsdam (AIP)

description:
Standalone Python code and a compact data subset for the manuscript Identifying Solar and Heliospheric Fronts With Conservation Laws and the MHD Riemann Problem.

The package reproduces three single-front tests, three regular Riemann fans and independent conservation checks, a Solar Orbiter MAG/SWA-PAS boundary diagnostic, SUVI and AIA positional comparisons, geometric checks, and seven Matplotlib figures. Full-precision inputs, a tested dependency list, reference results, data provenance and usage instructions are included.

The coronal states are prescribed. The image comparisons do not establish an observed complete fan, contact or rarefaction. Reproduction begins from the supplied image/profile subsets as documented in docs/DATA.md.

Apache-2.0 applies to code. Observational data retain their original terms: Solar Orbiter MAG and SWA data are distributed under CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO. See NOTICE for data credits and source-specific terms.
